Type: rug
Name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Contemporary Polyester Area Rug, 4 x 6 Foot, Light Green, Dark Green, White
Materials: polyester
This beautiful rug will enhance your home décor wherever you place it in your home. With its unique stripe pattern of dark green, light green, and white, this rug is ideal for any transitional-style room. This rug is hand tufted and suitable for both indoor and outdoor use. 4'W x 6'L Imported. 80% polyester, 20% polypropylene Hand tufted with a striped pattern and suitiable for indoor or outdoor use. High .6" pile suits any indoor/outdoor space Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
